answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 73 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in river, queued in canyon, and karst publishes the wait time. A farm of 225 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1449 identities would post 3948 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
